environment.description: Same application deployed on EC2 in private subnet (no IGW route). Origin is fronted by CloudFront distribution (d111111abcdef8.cloudfront.net) configured with Origin Access Control (OAC) using SigV4 signing. The origin's security group (sg-0def456) restricts inbound TCP/8080 to the AWS CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing, pl-3b927c52). CloudFront distribution has a custom cache behavior for /api/v1/* that requires signed URLs (Trusted Key Group: kg-0a1b2c3d4e with RSA-2048 key pair). Signed URLs use canned policy with 300-second expiry. The CloudFront distribution's origin request policy forwards only the 'payload' form field and strips all other headers. Additionally, the EC2 instance has no public IP and no elastic IP assigned; the only network path is via CloudFront through the VPC endpoint-adjacent prefix list routing.

config.deployment: EC2 t3.medium, Amazon Linux 2023, private subnet
config.security_group: sg-0def456: inbound TCP/8080 from pl-3b927c52 (CloudFront prefix list) ONLY
config.network: private subnet, no IGW route, no public IP, no elastic IP
config.cloudfront_signed_urls: Trusted Key Group kg-0a1b2c3d4e, RSA-2048, canned policy, 300s TTL
config.cloudfront_behavior: /api/v1/* requires signed URL, unsigned requests return 403
config.origin_request_policy: forwards 'payload' form field only, custom headers stripped
